connect.self: A node cannot be connected to itself
connect.fromOutput: The result node has no output
connect.toStart: The start node has no input
connect.cycle: This connection would create a cycle. To repeat steps, lead back from a branch of a decision or approval.
connect.pickBranch: Drag the connection from a branch of the decision or approval.
connect.loopCreated: Loop created: the steps run again, at most 3 times. Set the limit in the inspector.
connect.loopNeeded: This connection leads back and must stay a loop.

nodes.judgeTip: Quality check on: a judge checks the result and has the agent revise it if needed.
nodes.issuesTip: The configuration is incomplete or contradictory. Select the agent to see the messages in the inspector.

canvas.autoLayout: Arrange automatically: nodes from left to right by data flow
canvas.edgeLabel: Connection from {{source}} to {{target}}. Delete removes it.
canvas.dropInvalid: This item cannot be placed on the canvas.

palette.title: Building blocks
palette.itemTip: {{hint}} – drag onto the canvas or click
palette.conditionHint: Branches by rules, no AI request
palette.subworkflowHint: Runs another workflow as one step
palette.orchestratorHint: An AI model delegates the task to teams

inspector.startText: The workflow begins here. The input given at start flows to all connected agents.
inspector.outputText: Collects the result of the connected agents as the workflow's output.
inspector.label: Label
inspector.selectNode: Select a node to configure it.
inspector.budgetHint: Leave empty to use the default budget from the settings.
inspector.maxParallel: Most steps running at the same time
inspector.maxParallelHint: 1 to {{max}}. Further ready steps wait for a free slot. Empty = no limit.
inspector.timeLimitHint: Active run time; waiting for approvals does not count. Empty = no limit.
inspector.maxStepsHint: 1 to {{max}}. Every executed node counts, every loop round again. Empty = no limit.
inspector.capabilitiesHint: Short tags for what this workflow can do as a team, e.g. “research”. A comma or Enter adds one, at most {{max}}. They grant no permissions.
inspector.controlDrag: Drag building blocks from the palette onto the canvas, or click them
inspector.controlConnect: Drag from the right port to the left port to connect agents
inspector.controlPanels: Drag the dividers to resize the panels; double-click a node to show its properties

design.title: Design an agent with AI
design.question: What should the agent do?
design.hint: Describe the task, inputs, desired result and quality standard. The Agent Architect proposes role, system prompt, model, effort and tools.
design.placeholder: e.g. An agent that rates incoming customer requests by urgency and drafts a polite reply.
design.review: Review the proposal. It is written into the node only when you click “Apply”, and stays editable afterwards.
design.missingTools: The Architect would also need these tools:
design.missingToolsHint: You can have the AI create them in the tool library.

memoryAssistant.title: Set up memory with AI
memoryAssistant.question: What should the agent remember?
memoryAssistant.hint: The assistant proposes a clear file structure under /memories. Nothing is saved without your confirmation.
memoryAssistant.placeholder: e.g. Preferences of individual customers, decisions made and open items per project.

run.title: Start workflow
run.inputHint: Goes to every agent connected to the start (or without predecessors).
run.filesHint: Placed directly into the context of the first agents.
run.budgetText: Budget for this run: {{budget}}. The run stops as soon as it is exceeded.
run.providerMissing: Not set up yet: {{providers}}. Agents with these models cannot run.

page.unsavedText: The workflow has changes that have not been saved yet.
page.discardText: All unsaved changes and the undo/redo history are discarded. The editor loads the last saved state.

check.title: Check
check.showConnection: Highlight the connection in the editor

panels.resizeHint: Drag or use the arrow keys to resize. Double-click restores the default size.

loop.title: Loop
loop.text: Following this branch runs the steps from the target to here again. The first run counts as round 1.
loop.maxIterationsHint: 2 to {{max}}. Every round costs tokens again.
loop.placeholders: In the task of a step in the loop, {{iteration}} is the round, {{previous}} its own result of the round before and {{feedback}} what came back over the loop.
